versions.changelog:
- Initial release of pool-chemistry-pilot skill.
- Calculates precise chemical dosing (chlorine, acid, borax, etc.) from user-provided test results and pool volume.
- Diagnoses common water issues (cloudy/green water, irritation) and checks for unsafe conditions (high CYA, low FC/CYA ratio, pH drift).
- Models chlorine/CYA physics and prints a step-by-step chemical treatment sequence, tailored to your pool.
- Provides generic, chemistry-first recommendations—never equipment or product sales.
- All interactions and state stored locally in JSON; works offline.
